snippet.title: SULFUR - 1.0 & Consoles Release Date Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about SULFUR: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2124120/SULFUR/

SULFUR leaves Early Access and launches in 1.0 on PC on October 28, 2026, alongside its console debut on PlayStation 5, XBOX Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and Nintendo Switch 2.

SULFUR is a single-player FPS roguelike with deeply customizable weapons, hundreds of gun oils and attachments, cooking, loot, and extraction. Developed by Perfect Random.

SULFUR Store Pages:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2124120/SULFUR/
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10007890
XBOX: https://www.xbox.com/sv-SE/games/store/sulfur/9p37qqcptr8m
Nintendo: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/sulfur-switch/

--

What is the Triple-i Initiative?

We’re simply a bunch of studios banding together to share exciting news to our players, in a short show packed with back-to-back trailers. That’s it - no extra fluff, no ads, no host, just games. We’re talking world premieres, exclusive gameplay, launch dates, demo drops and more!

You can learn more at https://iii-initiative.com
